source: FinanceData/marcap (KRX daily market data for all listed stocks, column Close = official KRX unadjusted closing price) https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FinanceData/marcap/master/data/marcap-{2014..2025}.parquet, rows Code=011200. Value = last KRX session close on/before each calendar quarter end (KRX is shut on 31 Dec, so year-end keys hold the last December session). Keys start 2017-12-31 like the transcribed series: earlier periods include capital reductions with non-uniform ratios/debt-equity swaps, so no clean split basis exists. No splits since; share-count changes 2017-2025 in the source are CB/BW conversions, rights/third-party issues and cancellations, which are not split-adjusted (raw close used).
